# WorldAtlas.com

> > Comprehensive geographic reference resource covering world maps, continents, countries, flags, and geographic facts across Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, and South America.

WorldAtlas.com serves as a central hub for geographic information, providing detailed atlases, maps, and reference materials for all continents and countries. The site includes specialized resources such as US state abbreviations, postal codes, and USPS history alongside its core geographic content.

## Key Topics

- World Maps and Atlases
- Continents (Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, South America)
- Countries and Flags
- Geographic Facts and Data
- US State Abbreviations
- USPS and Postal Codes
- ZIP Code System
- Two-Letter State Codes
- Navigation and Geography
- Zonal Improvement Plan
- Publication 59
- Mailing Addresses

## World Atlas and Maps

- [World Atlas / World Map / Atlas of the World Including Geography Facts and Flags](https://www.worldatlas.com/aatlas/world.htm): Main world atlas hub with maps of continents: Africa, Asia, Europe, Americas

## United States Reference

- [USA States (Two-Letter Abbreviations)](https://www.worldatlas.com/geography/usa-states.html): Reference guide for US state two-letter abbreviations and USPS postal codes
